ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels and 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels primarily concentrated in the central and peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dense, contiguous dark-pixel mass is centered around the median notch, extending symmetrically onto the base of both lobes. Significant dark linear streaks and focal clusters are scattered across the mid-sections of both lobes. Dark pixel banding is observed along sections of the trailing and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; bounding box depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge. Notable irregular peaks and valleys located on the distal third of the left lobe and the medial section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer trailing edges, sweeping symmetrically upwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular clusters detected on the distal tip of the left lobe and the central-upper region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected. Left lobe features a cluster of at least four parallel diagonal dark streaks. Right lobe exhibits one prominent near-horizontal streak extending approximately 20% of the lobe width and several smaller diagonal marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive rake marks (parallel linear scars) on both lobes; significant pigmentation loss/scarring on the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, irregular butterfly-shaped dark pigmentation pattern emanating from the peduncle attachment point across the lower-medial fluke surface.
